notes: Catch-up run. No observatory run happened from 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-19, so the window is 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-20 CT. The seven run-2026-10-15 carry-overs were scored first, then eight new papers ranked by bound-claim relevance. Harvest rows were deduplicated by arXiv id across queries (115 rows, 89 unique) and against catalog.json (0 already present). ingest.py was not executed because it has no inter-request sleep and would replace the run log with a non-schema payload; its QUERIES were issued at 3.1 s spacing. No PDF cached; DBE_FULLTEXT_STORE unset. No claim, version, freeze or prompt file was edited. Files agree with the freeze (DBE-0.2.2 / DBES-0.2.0, claims freeze 2026-10-02). Q=1000 remains a ledger stress test.
